description: Add to Calendar files (RFC 5545) and the bare-day rule (FlowKit ICalendar and AirDateFormatting.isBareDay, web/src/lib/ics.ts and airDates.ts). Expected text for build is filled in from the RFC by hand in the file, see the cases.

cases.name: a day with no time is bare
midnight UTC is bare
midnight UTC with milliseconds is bare
a moment with a time is not bare
one second past midnight is not bare
midnight in another zone is not midnight UTC
two in the morning at +02:00 is midnight UTC
a Trakt first_aired evening is not bare
an empty calendar
an all-day event for a bare air day
cases.expected:
BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Marquee//Upcoming//EN
CALSCALE:GREGORIAN
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:show-1396-s01e02@flow-app
DTSTAMP:20261101T120000Z
DTSTART;VALUE=DATE:20261027
DTEND;VALUE=DATE:20261028
TRANSP:TRANSPARENT
SUMMARY:Breaking Bad S01E02
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
